full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J.: In this petition the plaintiffs seek leave to appeal from the judgment and order dated 20 August 1997 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1859 of 1994. By the said order the dismissal of the suit by the Court of first instance was restored in reversal of the decree of the appellate court.
